title: 0. Your own world (template)
description: Edit the JSON, then load it. Sources need a trust level (trusted, unverified or quarantined) and an origin (copies of the same claim share one). Beliefs and decisions list their reasons in "because": each reason is a list of ids that are ALL needed, and ANY one reason is enough. Ids start with s_, b_ or d_. Give a source a "text" and a reason a "quote" to put the Researcher's checks to work.

beliefs.claim: Something only the first source says

decisions.summary: An order that needs both beliefs
